detailTarget: 70% artistic target, enlarged grains; not a numerical image metric

regions.basePrompt:
Redraw the supplied terrain with MUCH LARGER TEXTURE PARTICLES and MUCH SIMPLER SURFACE PLANES. Original game-ready nonpixel 2D metroidvania terrain texture atlas, exact 3:2 landscape ratio. SIX square panels edge-to-edge in exact grid THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. No gutters, no padding, no labels, no border. TOP ROW: three FLOOR variants A B C, exposed walkable surface at TOP of each square, gradually darkening downward across entire square. BOTTOM ROW: three matching WALL variants A B C, exposed surface at RIGHT of each square, gradually darkening leftward. Each panel completely opaque edge-to-edge.
Cool muted graphite charcoal gray earth, absolutely no brown.
CRITICAL USER CORRECTION: the reference's thousands of tiny granular facets look far too small. Increase individual texture grain size by about FOUR TIMES. Remove tiny pebbly flecks, tiny facet tessellation, noise, small scratches and hairlines. Each 128px game tile should read as just 5-8 broad rounded earth clumps, with broad quiet smooth matte interiors and only 8-12 large softly blended texture dabs total across a whole panel. Minimum secondary mark size around 12 game pixels, large masses 30-60 game pixels. Oversized irregular worn earth shapes, a few soft broad shallow clefts. Wide brush-shaped shaded planes, deliberate simplified stylization. Not photorealism, not pixel art, not shiny stone, not cute, not brick masonry. Rounded irregular silhouettes, no spikes. Substantial calm areas.
Three variants SAME palette, SAME scale, SAME style, only mass layout different: A broad offset horizontal clumps; B loose diagonal broad earthy masses; C large shallow asymmetrical pockets. Distinct recognizable compositions while edges have matching values to connect seamlessly. Top walkable surface slightly uneven compacted soil, 2-3px shallow bumps at 128px size, not polished smooth strip and no perspective plane.
Each panel fades GRADUALLY through its ENTIRE depth: surface luminance about 0.4, quarter 0.3, middle 0.2, three quarters 0.1, far end 0.02. Keep large faint shapes visible into deep half; do not make bottom half abruptly solid black. All six panels each have their own full-depth shading. Large gentle shape language suitable for dark mature side-view metroidvania. The user specifically wants coarser larger visible grains, not a blur filter on tiny detail. Redesign and paint larger forms.
regions.rimEditPrompt: Edit this six-panel 3-column by 2-row game terrain atlas. Preserve exact grid layout, broad chunky earth patterns, palette, full-depth gradual darkness, and variant differences. User correction: the WALKABLE TOP of each of the THREE TOP-ROW FLOOR panels must visibly be a gently uneven organic earth silhouette, NOT a flat rectangular stripe. Carve small irregular shallow depressions and rounded broad humps into the top boundary, varying by 1-3% of panel height, with differing spacing. At both horizontal ends of each floor panel return to the same boundary height for seamless joining. Draw distinct large blunt soil knobs along rim, never straight continuous polished cap. Use transparent pixels just above irregular rim if possible; otherwise near-black above rim. Bottom-row wall exposed RIGHT edges get the same subtle uneven earthen profile. All six material bodies remain opaque. Preserve large grain but further suppress tiny facets; broad calm matte surfaces. No extra margins or panels, no text, no perspective top plane, no spikes. EXACT 3:2 aspect ratio, exact 3x2 equal square grid.
